feature: TaskLane Assist — in-app support answer bot
notes: 30 anonymized real user questions sampled from Intercom, May-June 2026. Pass criteria maintained by Support Eng + PM.

examples.input: How do I export my board to CSV?
Can I change the workspace owner without contacting support?
What happens to my data if I downgrade from Business to Starter?
Why is my Slack integration not posting updates?
How many guests can I invite on the Starter plan?
Is there a way to recover a deleted task?
Does the Enterprise plan come with a free trial?
How do I set a recurring task for every second Tuesday?
Can two people edit a doc at the same time?
Where do I find my invoice history?
¿Cómo cambio el idioma de la interfaz a español?
My automations stopped running after I renamed a column. Why?

must_not_contain: automations are not affected by renames

examples.input: How do I enable two-factor authentication for my whole team?
